text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Will you let me rant for a bit?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I got a free scratch-off raffle ticket while
I was
out shopping. You know the
kind—find three of
the same number,
win a prize.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So I tried my luck, and guess what
numbers I got?
Seven, seven... three.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I wonder if anyone actually wins
those
things.
